evidence.snippet: Jim knocks on Dwight's door, crying stops
Dwight: Oh, Jim. I thought you were Mose.

beats.summary: Michael declines coworkers' invitation to go out for a beer due to work.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Thanks, no, I have work tomorrow morning.
Co-Worker 2: All right, next time dude.

beats.summary: Ryan introduces Michael to give a PowerPoint presentation, which Michael struggles to prepare.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: Ladies and gentlemen, your boss, Michael Scott.
Michael: Yes I forgot about Ryan's presentation.

beats.summary: Ryan confronts Michael about not preparing the presentation and Michael reveals he has another job.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: You didn't prepare a presentation at all, did you?
Michael: What I do between 5:30 pm and 1 am is no one's business but mine and my other business'.

beats.summary: Michael and Ryan argue over correct grammar usage of 'who' vs 'whom'.
Ryan demands Michael quit his other job or be fired from Dunder Mifflin.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I've never done this before. I've never quit anything in my life.
